events.continuity_hook: Turns the narrowed upper Midwest route from the prior session into flights, car, and rooms before the refundable holds lapse.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the airport pairing, flight windows, rental-car pickup and return plan, and hotel sequence; note window-seat selection, parking, breakfast timing, dinner access after Madison, and receipt details.
events.scenario_brief: Airfare is now bookable for the upper Midwest loop. A Sunday afternoon Salt Lake City to Milwaukee Delta one-stop protects the Monday suburban Milwaukee counselor breakfast, and a Wednesday late-afternoon O'Hare return after the Rockford transfer event avoids backtracking to Milwaukee. The trade-off is a higher one-way rental-car charge versus a calmer Wednesday departure, and Tessa also needs to decide which Milwaukee-area and Rockford-area hotel holds should become bookings.

events.continuity_hook: Closes the upper Midwest planning with a final hotel and morning-drive decision after a schedule change.
events.interaction_goal: Decide whether to keep Janesville or switch to Rockford, then confirm cancellation timing, Wednesday drive buffer, parking, fuel stop, and airport return steps.
events.scenario_brief: Just before the upper Midwest trip, the Rockford host adds an 8:15 a.m. counselor coffee ahead of the Wednesday transfer event. The O'Hare return and rental car are already booked, but the Tuesday night hotel can still be changed from Janesville to Rockford. Janesville is cheaper and includes breakfast, while Rockford shortens the morning drive and has easier dinner options after the Beloit visit.

events.continuity_hook: Begins the next fall recruitment episode after the upper Midwest trip is wrapped up.
events.interaction_goal: Map the route order, compare Portland and Eugene airport pairings, identify hotel areas with breakfast and dinner access, and flag parking or rental-car issues before Tessa places refundable holds.
events.scenario_brief: Tessa starts planning a mid-October western Oregon recruitment loop with a Monday evening counselor reception in Beaverton, Tuesday morning high-school visits in Salem, a Wednesday afternoon transfer table near Albany, and a Thursday morning counselor breakfast in Eugene. She needs Salt Lake City flights, a rental car, and practical hotel zones. The main unresolved choices are whether to arrive Sunday evening or Monday afternoon, and whether to return from Eugene or drive back to Portland for a better flight schedule.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the western Oregon route after event times and room availability become clearer.
events.interaction_goal: Rank the Beaverton, Salem, Albany, Corvallis, and Eugene hotel options; identify the safest overnight sequence and list breakfast times, parking, cancellation dates, and late-arrival food choices to confirm.
events.scenario_brief: The Oregon hosts tighten the schedule: the Beaverton reception will end around 8:40 p.m., the first Salem visit moves to 7:45 a.m., and the Albany transfer table may run until 5:30 p.m. Salem hotels with included breakfast are limited, Albany and Corvallis rates are high because of a campus weekend, and Eugene has easier Thursday-morning access but requires a later Wednesday drive. Tessa needs the hotel sequence narrowed before holds expire.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Oregon plan from route shaping into a bookable flight, car, and hotel decision.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the arrival day, return airport, flight set, rental-car timing, and hotel holds to book; include seat selection, reimbursement notes, breakfast logistics, and the last cancellation dates.
events.scenario_brief: Flight prices shift for the Oregon loop. A Monday midday Salt Lake City to Portland nonstop can work for the Beaverton reception if traffic cooperates, while a Sunday evening arrival costs a little more but removes much of the arrival risk. For the return, a Thursday midafternoon Eugene itinerary saves the drive back to Portland but has a connection; the Portland nonstop is cheaper but adds rental-car time after the Eugene breakfast. The Beaverton, Salem, and Eugene hotel holds expire the same evening.

events.continuity_hook: Handles a final Oregon timing change after the core flights and rooms are in place.
events.interaction_goal: Decide whether to keep or change the final hotel night, then set the Thursday morning drive plan, breakfast workaround, fuel stop, luggage timing, and airport arrival buffer.
events.scenario_brief: A few days before departure, the Eugene counselor breakfast moves from downtown to Springfield, and the Eugene return flight is retimed 35 minutes earlier. The Sunday Portland arrival, rental car, and Eugene return are already booked. The unresolved choice is whether to keep the current Eugene airport-area hotel for easier flight logistics or switch to a Springfield hotel closer to the breakfast venue, while still leaving enough time for rental-car return.
